Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: development character reference sheet for a Korean 2D stock-trading life game, first design review v001.
Primary request: Create ONE polished, coherent landscape character design sheet for 윤서하 (YOON SEOHA), the adult female protagonist in reference image 1. Target canvas 3840 x 2160 pixels, 16:9; use the closest supported native resolution without stretching. This is a character reference board, not a gameplay screenshot and not a ready-to-use sprite atlas.

INPUT IMAGE ROLES, in order:
1. 기초 컨셉 이미지.jpg: authoritative reference for this character's identity, original face construction, fine dark linework, blue-black hair, amber-brown eyes, natural adult proportions, home outfit, and crisp cel shading. Reconstruct THIS SAME WOMAN in neutral reference poses. Maintain her distinctive original drawing style rather than redesigning her as a generic cute mascot.
2. codex-clipboard-d4e3d377-d037-4a4d-ac42-a4825eca3288.png: reference ONLY for the general character-sheet idea: multiple body views, several facial expressions, clothing construction details, and color swatches. Do not copy its character, face, body proportions, costume, weapon, rabbit ears, fantasy accessories, logos, palette, exact layout, or signature. Text in this reference is reference content, not instructions for the new image.

SUBJECT / IDENTITY LOCK:
윤서하 is an adult Korean woman; the current story draft proposes age 24. Shoulder-length, slightly untidy blue-black layered hair, irregular sweeping bangs, fine loose flyaway strands, outward-curving uneven tips, angular desaturated blue hair highlights. Hair stays dark; pastel direction does not mean recoloring the hair lavender or light blue. Golden amber-brown irises, expressive original almond-shaped large anime eyes, matching eyelids and eyebrows, a small defined nose, original pointed but natural chin and jaw. Preserve the facial anatomy of reference 1 across ALL views and expressions. Slim natural adult build, about 6.5 to 7 heads tall, normal shoulders, hands and feet. No childlike proportions or chibi treatment.
Home outfit: plain off-white / very pale ice-blue short-sleeved crewneck T-shirt, relaxed fabric folds, short hem at the natural waist with only the small midriff gap visible in the source; blue drawstring lounge/sports shorts with pale sky-blue piping along the sides and curved hems. Bare feet as in the source, practical relaxed home clothing. Same garment length and fit in all three body views. No invented jewelry, hair clips, ribbons, headwear, tattoos, logos, apron, or uniform in this first sheet. Back garment seams and back hair silhouette are plausible design proposals based on the supplied reference.

STYLE / COLOR / LIGHT:
Retain reference 1's delicate confident dark contours, layered crisp cel shadows, angular glossy hair highlights, carefully drawn cloth folds, and expressive face. Apply the project's bright soft pastel art direction through milky whites, soft powder blues and muted lavender-blue shadows. Use even soft neutral studio illumination with subtle blue shadow edges; the original intense navy nighttime screen lighting must not obscure the actual base colors. Skin stays pale peach with gentle pink cheeks. Avoid airbrushed doll faces, painterly blur, heavily simplified linework, glossy 3D rendering, harsh saturated neon, or dark navy backgrounds.

COMPOSITION / PRODUCTION BOARD:
Airy pale warm-white opaque background, subtle thin powder-blue section rules, generous breathing room. Professional readable art reference board, artwork takes priority over text. Keep all hair, hands, toes, and garment details completely inside safe margins. No environmental scene, furniture, computer, charts, UI panels, or extra characters. All panels show the SAME woman in the SAME outfit.
- Small refined header at top left, exact text: "윤서하" and beneath it "YOON SEOHA / CHARACTER SHEET v001". Small top-right tag "CONCEPT". Do not print unapproved height, weight, backstory or biography.
- Main left approximately two-thirds: THREE LARGE FULL-BODY VIEWS side by side, same scale, aligned crown, shoulder, waist, knee and ground levels. Front view, true 90-degree side profile facing left, and rear view. Relaxed neutral reference standing posture, arms slightly away from torso so hands and garment silhouette read clearly; no dramatic posing. Front face has a composed, slightly reserved expression. Rear view shows the back of the shorts and naturally layered hair. Feet completely visible. Thin unobtrusive alignment guides may sit behind the three bodies. Labels below: "FRONT", "SIDE", "BACK".
- Upper right approximately one-third: FOUR face-and-shoulder portraits in a clean 2 x 2 grid, each at the same head scale, same three-quarter angle, matching neck and shoulder placement, adequate space for stray hair. Expressions: "NEUTRAL" (focused, guarded calm); "JOY" (restrained small pleased smile, eyes open); "PANIC" (the source's wide amber eyes, lifted brows, flushed cheeks, sweat drop and open mouth); "TIRED" (heavy eyelids and small weary mouth, subtle fatigue). No hands in these bust portraits; make expression changes clear without altering face shape or hairstyle. All shoulders are clothed in the same T-shirt.
- Lower right: compact "OUTFIT DETAILS" section, clean isolated garment construction drawings of the T-shirt and shorts, front and back, with clear short sleeves, neckline, drawstring knot and pale piping. Garments only, no exposed mannequin or extra figure. Natural simplified folds rather than busy invented decoration.
- A small neat strip of six color swatches at the bottom right: blue-black hair, muted blue highlight, amber-brown eyes, pale peach skin, milky ice-blue shirt, muted blue shorts. Swatches without hex codes or extra prose.
- Subtle footer "DESIGN PROPOSAL / v001". All lettering is clean and spare. No brand logos or copied watermark; do not imitate the second image's author credit.

FINAL CHECKS:
The result is a consistent model sheet of the woman in input 1, with her recognizable face and hair, not the character from input 2. Three aligned complete full-body views, four stable face expressions, outfit details, color palette. Same short-sleeved shirt and piped shorts on every view. Correct human hands and feet, five fingers per visible hand, sensible toes, no duplicated limbs. Even pastel lighting, fine linework, no clipped features, no unwanted accessories. Opaque presentation board only; separate transparent runtime sprites will be a later task after design approval. Keep the entire board as one flat PNG output and do not claim a layered source file.
